Enum Class VisionConstants.Camera

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<VisionConstants.Camera>
com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.vision.VisionConstants.Camera
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<VisionConstants.Camera>, Constable
Enclosing interface:
VisionConstants
public static enum VisionConstants.Camera extends Enum<VisionConstants.Camera>
Represents a camera from its physical position and identified by name.

An constant of this enum looks like this NAME("detailed name", new Transform3d(x, y, z, rotation), 1.0);

      private Camera(String name, org.wpilib.math.geometry.Transform3d robotToCamera, double stdDevFactor)
      Internal constructor to setup a camera with a VisionConstants.CameraData instance
      Parameters:
      name - name of the camera, can be more detailed than its simple enum constant's name
      robotToCamera - transformation from the robot origin to the camera's position
      stdDevFactor - scalar factor to multiply the camrea's standard deviations by
